name: The Virus
source:
It is an conscious entity living in the brain of Doori Kiss, occasionally taking control over her body. 
It behaves strangely and is aware of many things that most people wouldn't consider. 
[spoiler]It is an virus created by Tokorokiyama which revived the comatose Doori Kiss by taking over the damaged parts of her brain.
translation:
It is an conscious entity living in the brain of Doori Kiss, occasionally taking control over her body. 
It behaves strangely and is aware of many things that most people wouldn't consider. 
[spoiler]It is an virus created by Tokorokiyama which revived the comatose Doori Kiss by taking over the damaged parts of her brain.
